🎯 Goal.what: Read the authored purpose and completion boundary. Source: Block board.md or Job face goal/spine.
🎯 Goal.example:
The walkthrough Job aims to run two loops on 30 synthetic chats.
Skills: haipipe-block, haipipe-job.

📋 Requirements.what: Read recorded requirements and questions; absence does not imply a requirement has passed. Source: face Requirements section and Questions register.
📋 Requirements.example:
Inspect the walkthrough’s recorded questions; do not invent missing acceptance criteria.
Skills: haipipe-report, haipipe-labeling.

🧠 MindMap.what: Inspect Topics and the actual work hierarchy. Source: Topics, Questions and real child folders.
🧠 MindMap.layout: Left tabs: Topics / Work Structure; right: diagram
🧠 MindMap.example:
Expand the walkthrough Job into Items, Meaning and Expression Tasks.
Skills: haipipe-mindmap, haipipe-studio.

📊 Job progress.what: Read each Job’s actual Task completion state. Band headings come from the Block. Source: Job faces and Task/Run state through status_now_html.
📊 Job progress.layout: Numbered Job bands → expandable Job / Task rows
📊 Job progress.example:
The walkthrough Job has a signed expression release while its item recipe still waits for a person.
Skills: haipipe-job, haipipe-task, haipipe-run.

📋 Tasks.what: Read each Task’s newest recorded state and result headline. Source: child Task faces and Run records.
📋 Tasks.layout: Task rows inside a numbered disclosure
📋 Tasks.example:
Items, Meaning and Expression retain independent progress; a release does not mark every Task done.
Skills: haipipe-task, haipipe-run.

🧩 View BJTR.what: Inspect the real Block → Job → Task → Run hierarchy by Topic. Source: Topic work links and existing child folders.
🧩 View BJTR.layout: Left Topic tabs · right expandable tree → record pop-out
🧩 View BJTR.example:
Choose a Topic and open an associated Run without allocating a new Run.
Skills: haipipe-studio, haipipe-job, haipipe-task, haipipe-run.

🔗 Dependencies.what: Read only authored dependency information; this section is conditional. Source: face Dependencies section.
🔗 Dependencies.example:
The walkthrough has no Dependencies section, so this bar is absent; opening Status shows the actual state.
Skills: haipipe-job, haipipe-task.

🏷 Final labels.what: Inspect the newest expression release result. Labels may be unsigned; the displayed signature state is authoritative. Source: Expression release Run result/final_labels.jsonl and its signature.
🏷 Final labels.layout: Numbered disclosure → label table and case details
🏷 Final labels.example:
The synthetic walkthrough exposes e02 labels. They demonstrate UI behavior, not a production-quality claim.
Skills: haipipe-labeling-expression, haipipe-labeling-final-labels.

🧠 The rules they follow.what: Read the approved meaning version associated with the Job. Omit this section when no approved version exists. Source: meaning_versions.approved_meaning and the Meaning Task results.
🧠 The rules they follow.example:
Inspect the walkthrough’s approved m02 rules beside its labels.
Skills: haipipe-labeling-interaction, haipipe-labeling-guideline.

📦 Signed releases.what: List only expression release Runs that are done and have a release signature. Actual bars are titled Final labels, release … . Source: release Run result/signed.yaml, final_labels files and runtime state.
📦 Signed releases.layout: One numbered disclosure per release → labels, file, rules, signed date and Run pop-out
📦 Signed releases.example:
Inspect e02’s signed release and open its final-label file; an unfinished or unsigned release must be excluded.
Skills: haipipe-labeling-expression, haipipe-labeling-final-labels.

📁 The Block's delivery/.what: Inspect existing handoff files when the delivery reader returns content. This section is conditional. Source: existing delivery/ artifacts.
📁 The Block's delivery/.example:
The walkthrough’s release files remain in their owning Run; no delivery directory is fabricated.
Skills: haipipe-delivery, haipipe-labeling-handoff.

🎨 Studio.what: Read Topics explicitly assigned to this View or linked by its Topic tags. Source: Topic faces and drawing files.
🎨 Studio.layout: Left Topic tabs · right drawing and content
🎨 Studio.example:
Open the matching walkthrough View. Unassigned records are reachable from its right rail; an empty scoped section is valid.
Skills: haipipe-studio.

🙋 Interactions.what: Read and answer only in-scope questions; the right rail includes unassigned questions. Source: interaction Run cards, forms and answers.

Open the matching walkthrough View. Unassigned records are reachable from its right rail; an empty scoped section is valid.
